headline: Stlican Shelf Flares Anew as Stonecradle Works Change Hands
war_summary: Three hours have brought stirring change to the old fronts. Stlican Shelf, quiet at our last writing, has erupted anew — eight actions in six hours, the latest barely a quarter of an hour old — and the Warden count there now reads seven works to two Colonial. Stonecradle has shifted further still: six Warden works to three, against four apiece and a ruin in the last edition, with Trammel Pool and The Heir's Knife busiest and nine actions in the past two hours. The Weathered Expanse keeps its lead atop the ledger with sixty-eight actions in the day, ten inside the last two hours, one work now demolished. Linn of Mercy has cooled for an hour and a half after a busy stretch, its works standing ten Colonial to one Warden. Callahan's Passage shows no ownership event at The Latch in better than nine hours, yet its casualty rolls swell past 8,300 Colonial and 6,500 Warden for the day, the hourly pace still climbing. Fresh Colonial captures mark Godcrofts and Fisherman's Row, where events ran nearly to this edition. Across the map the ledger counts 283 Colonial works to 152 Warden, one in ruin; it is the war's 221st day, with thirty-four victory towns still the prize.
